events.title: 볼턴 원더러스 pay a club record £3.5million for 윔블던 striker Dean Holdsworth .
반즐리 lose 5–0 to league leaders 아스널 at Highbury.
Referee David Ellery changes into a blue top for the second half of the Premier League game between 리즈 유나이티드 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 , after his original green shirt clashed with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's away kit.
Paul Peschisolido becomes the first player to join a third-tier club for a seven-figure sum when he joins 풀럼 for £1.1million from 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 .
반즐리 are on the receiving end of yet another heavy defeat, this time a 7–0 hammering by 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford which sends the hosts to the top of the table.

맨체스터 유나이티드 finish October as Premier League leaders, leapfrogging 아스널 into second place, while 블랙번 로버스 have got their title challenge back on track by climbing into third place. 첼시 and 리버풀 complete the top five, with 레스터 시티, 더비 카운티 and 윔블던 putting immense pressure on them. A dismal run of form has pushed 볼턴 원더러스 into bottom place, while 반즐리 occupying the next lowest position and 셰필드 웬즈데이 completing the bottom three. 노팅엄 포리스트 remain top of Division One, while 스윈던 타운's surprise challenge for a second promotion in three seasons continues as they now occupy second place. 미들즈브러 , 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 브래드퍼드 시티 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 complete the top six.
